correctness.rationale: The source correctly represents simultaneous forbidden repeated-operand sums/products as an independent-set graph with loops at c/2 and square roots of c. Projective completion by two involutions s(x)=c-x,m(x)=c/x gives alternating components. The semisimple ratio h=sm partitions non-fixed points by PGL order; parity and square status determine the looped paths. The unipotent c=4 case is separately handled. Counting inverse-paired eigenvalue ratios in split/nonsplit 2-adic tori gives the claimed E_p. Independent networkx graph independence and direct projective composition checks agreed on 420 target cases in 15 prime fields <=59. Finite agreement is not a universal proof; the projective orbit argument supplies arbitrary p.
